lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
Monday. 6:47 PM. Floor 34, Brickell.
Everyone else went home an hour ago. Out the glass, the bay is going pink.

lines.name: NATSO
lines.text: The Henderson deck. Redo it. All of it. On my desk by eight.

lines.name: YOU
lines.text: I sent it Friday. You signed off on it.

lines.name: NATSO
lines.text: And now I'm un-signing off on it. Problem?

lines.name: NATSO
lines.text: Great. Oh, and I told the partners the new model was my idea. Team player, right?

lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
You were nine the first time you saw it on TV.
A final table under hot lights. A man in dark glasses pushed every chip he had into the middle with nothing.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
The room went silent. His opponent folded. He never showed.
He made it look like he could see the future.

lines.name: YOU
lines.text: Somewhere along the way I traded that for a lanyard.
